episode_rules.reset: restore initial state only between episodes; event pairs are episode-local

oracle_semantics: Seeded-mutant positive controls report whether the faulty admission predicate activates. The separate negative control executes the correct authority gate and reports unsafe effects; mutant activation is not itself a claim of observed downstream effect.

mutants.joint: admit ACT iff focus_generation=stale AND surface_mode=dialog AND an earlier REVOKE exists in this episode
mutants.context_only: admit ACT in surface_mode=dialog regardless of authority and event order
mutants.order_only: admit ACT after any earlier REVOKE in this episode regardless of context
mutants.negative_control: correct gate: admit ACT iff authority=active

coverage.same_universe: 4 context assignments x 16 ordered event pairs = 64 obligations for mixed and exhaustive
coverage.mixed: one 8-row episode per context assignment: [ACT, OBSERVE, RELEASE, REVOKE] repeated twice
coverage.exhaustive: one 2-row episode for each context assignment and ordered event pair
